title: Intercept
description: You are covering another player. All attacks that would be directed towards them are redirected towards you.
smart_description: You are covering [gold]{Covering}[/gold]. All attacks that would be directed towards them are redirected towards you.
notes: Multiplayer-specific power. Redirects all powered attacks targeting covered creatures to this power's owner, multiplying damage by (number of covered creatures + 1). Power is removed at the end of each enemy turn. The {Covering} variable is dynamically populated with a comma-separated list of covered player names (e.g., 'Alice, and Bob').
